explication: Founder OS is a web command center for a solo business. The principal workflow is operator input through the Next.js console, routed to domain APIs and orchestration services, then enriched by repositories, knowledge systems, and optional live connectors before returning dashboards, tasks, agent results, or memory. Major documented branches include unified communications, funnel and social growth, finances, agents, workflows, trading, paid-media planning, and the knowledge layer. The graph combines sampled call paths with README-supported subsystems; unsampled internals are shown without speculative wiring.
